All observed reflections are accounted for by the primitive tetragonal cell (a about 3.92848 A, c about 5.61485 A, Z=1), with about 0.0017 degree peak-position RMS and a full-profile residual near the measured baseline noise in the trace. The CIFs have the correct fully occupied YBiO2F2 composition, plausible density and coordination, and no short contacts. The diffraction does not uniquely resolve O/F ordering or distinguish P-4m2, P4mm, and metrically tetragonal Pmmm, but the submission explicitly instantiates the three symmetry-distinct 1:1 O/F orderings on the supported fluorite-derived framework as separate candidates rather than treating one averaged realization as resolved. Their fits are essentially homometric, while an independently checked, chemically motivated PbFCl-derived framework fits the integrated intensities substantially worse (about 18.3% relative residual versus about 4.18-4.20% for the submitted models). Although the supplied comparable-Rwp report is unavailable, there is no unexplained peak or plausible materially different framework indicated that warrants another attempt.
